problem_summary.F13b_gate_default_posture: validate_pre_live_gate_v25.py's verdict computation (run_gate, formerly lines 1490-1492) computed verdict = 'CONDITIONAL_GO' whenever active_blockers was empty and any Condition rows existed -- unconditionally. evaluate_pal_validation and evaluate_online_preflight both SKIP-by-default (no --pal-validation-file / no --allow-online-preflight) and emit Condition, never Blocker, on skip. split_findings_by_waiver only filters Blockers, never Conditions. Net effect: a run that does nothing about PAL/online-preflight exits CONDITIONAL_GO with zero operator action required -- the gate's weakest posture was its default posture.
problem_summary.F19b_fa8_preflight: run_provider_doctor_probe -> call_llm (run_extraction_v5.py, thin wrapper) -> llm_runtime.call_llm -> deps.build_chat_payload(provider='openrouter', model_id='openai/gpt-5.2', ...). resolve_temperature(provider, model_id, default_temp) (run_extraction_v5.py) only omits temperature when provider == 'openai' literally; for provider='openrouter' it always returns the default (0.1), regardless of the model_id being a gpt-5-family model reached through OpenRouter's 'openai/<model>' slug convention. OpenAI gpt-5* models reject any non-default temperature outright (documented elsewhere in the same file re: the --llm-temperature omission rule). OpenRouter forwards the rejected temperature to the upstream model, which 400s; classify_failure_type maps 400<=status<500 to failure_type='payload', and classify_provider_readiness_blocker maps {'payload','provider','unknown'} to blocker_code='AMBIGUOUS_PROVIDER_BLOCK' -- exactly FA-8-HIGH-1's reported symptom. The FA-8 regression test's own repro curl in its docstring omits the temperature field entirely and succeeds, which is the tell: the payload shape, not provider auth, is the defect.
problem_summary.F19c_gemini_timeout: llm_runtime.call_llm's Gemini-SDK branch called deps.get_gemini_client(api_key) with no second argument. The real get_gemini_client(api_key, timeout_seconds=None) (run_extraction_v5.py) only sets HttpOptions(timeout=...) on the SDK client when timeout_seconds is passed; omitting it means the client has no request-level deadline at all, so a hung Gemini call is not bounded by call_llm's overall_timeout_seconds/_remaining_timeout_seconds() bookkeeping -- that bookkeeping is computed but never actually reaches the Gemini client construction, unlike the HTTP and OpenAI/xAI/OpenRouter SDK branches which both pass timeout=_remaining_timeout_seconds() explicitly.
problem_summary.F19d_webhook_url_leak: reporting.write_run_manifest wrote 'dpmx_webhook_url': os.getenv(deps.dpmx_webhook_url_env, '').strip() verbatim into the 'cli' block of RUN_MANIFEST.json. Webhook URLs of the Slack/Discord-incoming-webhook shape are bearer-equivalent capability URLs -- anyone with the URL can post as the configured integration with no further auth. The adjacent dpmx_webhook_secret was already correctly boolean-only (dpmx_webhook_secret_set); the URL field was the sole leaky sibling. RUN_MANIFEST.json routinely lands in reports/ or gets attached to proof bundles (this very PROOF.json's own program), so this was a realistic secret-exposure path, not a theoretical one.
problem_summary.F14_max_cost_usd_help: Runtime cap enforcement auto-applies the active cost profile's max_cost_usd_default when --max-cost-usd is not explicitly passed (run_extraction_v5.py, 'Applied cost-profile default --max-cost-usd=%.2f for profile=%s' log line) -- a cap is ALWAYS in effect, never absent. The runner's own argparse --max-cost-usd flag (services/repo-truth-extractor/extractor/cli_args.py:384-388) is the only operator-facing surface that could hint at this, and its help text read only 'Hard per-run live spend cap in USD. Requires pricing coverage and partition_workers=1.' -- silent about the always-on profile default, reading instead like an optional override with no cap unless set. NOTE: the click-level `dopemux rte run --max-cost-usd` wrapper (src/dopemux/cli.py:5185-5189) already had truthful help text ('profile default applied when unset') from an unrelated June 2026 commit (685b417bb8, cost-profile-controls feature work) -- that surface required no change and was left untouched.

design_summary.F13b_fix: GateConfig gained allow_conditional: bool = False. build_arg_parser gained --allow-conditional (store_true, default False) with help text stating the un-opted-skip-is-NO_GO default explicitly. build_config wires args.allow_conditional through unmodified (no silent drop). run_gate's verdict block: verdict stays 'NO_GO' by default; if not active_blockers and condition_rows and not config.allow_conditional, verdict is explicitly 'NO_GO' (was previously always 'CONDITIONAL_GO' in this branch); only with allow_conditional=True does condition_rows produce 'CONDITIONAL_GO'. derive_operator_verdict gained a keyword-only allow_conditional: bool = True parameter (default True preserves prior GO_NOW behavior for any caller that does not thread the flag) and, after all blocker-classification branches return nothing, a new check: if conditions and not allow_conditional, return the new NO_GO_CONDITIONAL_NOT_ALLOWED bucket instead of falling through to GO_NOW -- so the operator-facing verdict, not just the raw 'verdict' string, reflects the un-opted-skip reasoning (per A5-ops-gates-proof.md §2.2 point 4's consistency requirement). run_gate's call site now passes allow_conditional=config.allow_conditional explicitly.
design_summary.F19b_fix: Scoped to llm_runtime.py (in file boundary) rather than run_extraction_v5.py's resolve_temperature (out of boundary, and provider-name-gated by design for the direct-OpenAI case it already handles correctly). New module-level _model_family_rejects_custom_temperature(model_id) matches the TRAILING model slug (str.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].startswith('gpt-5')), so both 'gpt-5.2' (direct) and 'openai/gpt-5.2' (OpenRouter-routed) are caught regardless of which provider name fronts the call. In call_llm, immediately after deps.build_chat_payload(...) returns payload, a defense-in-depth check strips 'temperature' from payload (copy-on-write, does not mutate the deps-provided dict) whenever the model is gpt-5-family and temperature is present -- covering both the openai_compat_http body/HTTP transport and the SDK chat_kwargs branch (which reads temperature FROM payload), so the fix applies uniformly regardless of transport.
design_summary.F19c_fix: The Gemini-SDK branch call site changed from deps.get_gemini_client(api_key) to deps.get_gemini_client(api_key, _remaining_timeout_seconds()) -- the exact same remaining-deadline budget already computed and used by the HTTP and OpenAI/xAI/OpenRouter SDK branches in this function, now also reaching Gemini client construction. LLMRuntimeDeps.get_gemini_client's type annotation updated from Callable[[str], Any] to Callable[[str, Optional[int]], Any] to reflect the real call shape (the underlying run_extraction_v5.get_gemini_client(api_key, timeout_seconds=None) function itself required no change -- it already accepted and correctly used the parameter; only the call site was dropping it).
design_summary.F19d_fix: The manifest key 'dpmx_webhook_url': os.getenv(...) became 'dpmx_webhook_url_set': bool(os.getenv(...).strip()) -- presence only, matching dpmx_webhook_secret_set's existing pattern exactly (same os.getenv(...).strip() truthiness check, same boolean coercion). The key is renamed (not left as a now-differently-typed 'dpmx_webhook_url'), so any downstream consumer expecting a URL string fails loudly (KeyError/AttributeError) rather than silently receiving a boolean where a URL was expected -- verified no such consumer exists (see verification below).
design_summary.F14_fix: services/repo-truth-extractor/extractor/cli_args.py's --max-cost-usd help text extended from 'Hard per-run live spend cap in USD. Requires pricing coverage and partition_workers=1.' to state explicitly that when unset, the active cost profile's default cap is auto-applied at runtime (referencing --cost-profile) and that this flag is the operator's only surfaced hint of that always-on behavior, before the pre-existing 'Requires pricing coverage...' sentence. Phrasing deliberately echoes the click-level wrapper's existing 'profile default applied when unset' language for consistency across the two surfaces.

fa8_disposition.rationale: The dispatch mandated dry-run-only execution: never --execute, never DPMX_LIVE_OK, no live provider calls anywhere. The FA-8 regression test (tests/regression/audit_2026_05_22/test_fa_8_high_1_preflight_probe.py) is skipif-gated on a real OPENROUTER_API_KEY and, when that key is present, makes an ACTUAL live HTTP/SDK call to OpenRouter via run_provider_doctor_probe -- there is no way to observe it genuinely XPASS without making the exact live provider call this packet is forbidden from making. Setting a fake key would not help: without real credentials the call would fail on auth, not reach the temperature-payload code path this fix targets, so a fake-key XPASS would be a false signal, not evidence. Per the dispatch's own instruction ('if it does not genuinely pass, leave the markers and report the probe still broken rather than deleting the evidence'), the skipif/xfail markers on this specific test are UNCHANGED. This is a deliberate, mandate-driven omission, not an oversight: removing the markers without live verification would have produced exactly the kind of unverifiable-but-claimed-fixed defect this program has repeatedly flagged as unacceptable.
fa8_disposition.offline_substitute_proof: A new, fully offline, no-API-key unit test (test_r2_004_go_live_safety_cluster.py::test_call_llm_strips_temperature_for_openrouter_routed_gpt5_model) reproduces FA-8-HIGH-1's exact route (provider='openrouter', model_id='openai/gpt-5.2', the same model_id the regression test's docstring cites) against llm_runtime.call_llm with a fake SDK client that captures the kwargs actually handed to chat.completions.create, and asserts 'temperature' is absent -- proving the payload-construction root cause is fixed at the unit level, independent of network access. This is the strongest verification obtainable under the no-live-calls constraint; it does not substitute for eventually running the real FA-8 regression test with real credentials in an environment where live calls are permitted, which remains the outstanding step to flip that test to genuine (not markers-removed-by-assumption) XPASS.
fa8_disposition.who_should_run_the_real_check: An operator or CI lane with OPENROUTER_API_KEY set AND explicit authorization to make a live provider call (outside this packet's dry-run-only mandate) should run: mise exec -- python -m pytest services/repo-truth-extractor/tests/regression/audit_2026_05_22/test_fa_8_high_1_preflight_probe.py -v. If it XPASSes, remove both the @pytest.mark.skipif and @pytest.mark.xfail decorators per the original dispatch instruction; if it still fails, the temperature-omission fix in this packet was necessary but not sufficient and further root-causing is needed.

risk_notes: F-13b changes default gate behavior for any existing automation that relies on the old CONDITIONAL_GO-on-skip default without ever setting --allow-conditional -- such automation will now see NO_GO where it previously saw CONDITIONAL_GO. This is the INTENDED fix (the packet's entire mandate), but is a breaking behavior change for any caller depending on the old default; --allow-conditional is the mitigation and is documented in its own --help text.
